conflicts_in.fact: Runner A's pace and Runner B's mid-race velocity are inconsistent, and the race cannot work out numerically
conflicts_in.versions: Lesson 1/2: Runner A ~19 km/h; Runner B ~17.6 km/h in 25-35 km. Lesson 5: Runner B drops from ~5.8 m/s (20.9 km/h) to 4.9 m/s (17.6 km/h) then 6.2 m/s (22.3 km/h). Lesson 7 model-building: Runner A 21 km/h, Runner B 17 km/h, relative speed 4 km/h, contradicting its own Explain section (19 vs 17.6, 1.4 km/h relative speed).

conflicts_in.fact: Time to close the 200 m overtaking gap at the relative speed
conflicts_in.versions: Explained: 1.4 km/h closing speed gives about 8.6 minutes for a 200 m gap (correct: 0.2/1.4 h ≈ 8.6 min). Model Building: 4 km/h relative speed for the same 200 m gap, giving 3 minutes. Same event, different numbers.

conflicts_in.fact: Where/when Runner B lost the lead and the slow section's location
conflicts_in.versions: Lesson 3: Runner A overtakes B during 30-35 km, B's lead exists at 30 km. Lesson 1/2/4/6/8: B ahead at 30 km but slow section 25-35 km. Lesson 7: A overtakes B with about 4 km to go (final stretch). Lesson 5: Runner B's sprint is km 35-42 and the slowdown is km 25-35. Lesson 2: sprint in final 2 km and slow section 25-35 km. Lesson 6 says sprint in last 2 km. The overtake point differs (30-35 km vs about 4 km to go).
